offering_description.value: Encore buys portfolios of charged-off consumer debt from banks and other lenders. It collects those accounts through its own collection operations and offers consumers payment plans and settlements. It also provides collection and account servicing for other creditors.

primary_services.value: consumer debt collection; repayment plan and settlement administration; third-party account servicing

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, credit unions, consumer lenders and other creditors that contract for collections or account servicing

end_markets.value: credit cards; consumer lending; specialty finance

revenue_model.value: other: repayments and settlements on purchased consumer receivables; service fees: collection and account servicing for other creditors

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: buys charged-off receivables from creditors and collects from consumers; service provider: takes on account servicing and collections for other creditors

geography_served.value: global: United States and United Kingdom, its main markets

specialization.value: related lines: consumer debt purchasing, collections and third-party account servicing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct relationships with lenders and other creditors; online: consumer account portals for payments and repayment arrangements

regulatory_exposure.value: high: U.S. state collection licensing and federal debt collection rules, UK Financial Conduct Authority authorization

notes: The exact current operating footprint outside the United States and United Kingdom is uncertain.
